# Security: Corner Bakery
> v1 · Approved 2026-11-29 by the bakery owner

## Who can get in
- Anyone using the bakery computer can open the tool. The tool has no sign-in.

## How it's protected
- **Records:** orders stay on the bakery computer.
- **Database:** none. Records are files.
- **Sign-in:** none.
- **Connections:** only the order notice goes to the email service.
- **Audit:** none.

## Secrets
- Keep the mail settings outside the code.

## Personal data
- The order records hold no names or contact details.

## Outside services
- The email service receives the order reference and pickup date.

## Work rules
- Use the bakery computer.

## If something goes wrong
- **Tell first:** the bakery owner.
- **Do first:** record open orders on paper.
- **Tell the people affected:** tell customers who are waiting for pickup.
